audienceHypotheses: Adults in Vietnam who want a calm, private reflection ritual for questions and emotions.
People who already use general AI but want a more designed reflection flow with a clear next step.
People interested in Tarot, self-discovery and journaling without deterministic spiritual promises.
exclusions: No targeting or inference based on health, mental state, relationship hardship, religion, birth profile, Tarot result, chat, journal or face data.
No minors in the Sprint 01 research or beta hypothesis.

northStar.meaning: A person voluntarily finds value on at least two distinct days, rather than only opening the app once.
